_help: Android Builder settings. name = app name on the phone, id = package id, iconUrl = link to an icon image (or use the App icon button), versionName/versionCode = app version, minSdk/targetSdk = Android API levels (web apps), release = true builds a Play Store bundle (.aab), tv = true adds Android TV support (website and web apps), repo = GitHub repo used to build (blank = auto-create). Keep valid JSON.
